claim_boundaries: Only deterministic canonical generated owned-source PPTX cross-copy is measured.
The result is prepared in-memory plan/commit/publication evidence, not end-to-end file save or cold/storage I/O.
Control and candidate physical ZIP hashes intentionally differ; semantic/topology gates are equal and each revision is internally deterministic.
Raw noncanonical-member preservation and exact inverse are established by production tests, not by this historical harness corpus.
No source-backed ReadAt, borrowed-source physical, remote/range, decompressed/recompressed-byte, general OPC/PPTX CRUD, other-format, or iWork claim is made.
Plain publication p95/p99 are withheld because candidate same-implementation drift exceeded thresholds.
Heaptrack and time -v are whole-process observations and not operation-local memory attribution.

protocol.timing_scope: plan + atomic commit + sequential OPC publication; setup/reopen/semantic/topology/closure/refusal gates excluded

heaptrack.scope: one whole clean process per revision; media-rich; 0 warmups + 1 sample; descriptive only

perf_stat.scope: whole clean process; media-rich; 3 warmups + 10 samples; CPU 2

time_v.scope: whole clean process; media-rich; 3 warmups + 30 samples; not operation-local

scope: prepared owned-source PPTX cross-presentation copy over deterministic canonical plain and eight-by-2-MiB-media corpora
